name: CLEMATIS ERECTA
key_symptoms: After eating, weakness in all limbs and pulsation in arteries.
Boring pain in temples. Confused feeling; better in open air. Eruption on occiput at base of hair, moist, pustular sensitive, itching.
guiding_symptoms: After eating, weakness in all limbs and pulsation in arteries.
Boring pain in temples. Confused feeling; better in open air. Eruption on occiput at base of hair, moist, pustular sensitive, itching.

worse: at night, and warmth of bed (washing in cold water)

head_symptoms: Boring pain in temples. Confused feeling; better in open air. Eruption on occiput at base of hair, moist, pustular sensitive, itching.
gi_symptoms: After eating, weakness in all limbs and pulsation in arteries.
urinary_symptoms: Tingling in urethra lasting some time after urinating. Frequent, scanty urination; burning at orifice. Interrupted flow. Urethra feels constricted. Urine emitted drop by drop. Inability to pass all the urine; dribbling after urinating. Pain worse at night, pain along the spermatic cord. Commencing stricture.
skin_symptoms: Red, burning, vesicular, scaly, scabby. Itches terribly; worse, washing in cold water; worse face and hands and scalp around occiput. Glands hot, painful, swollen; worse inguinal glands. Glandular indurations and tumors of breast. Varicose ulcers.

source.title: CLEMATIS ERECTA - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
